'''Three-handed princess''' was a type of game. It was available for play in the [[Corusca Gem casino]], a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
